contributions.detail: DELTA 2,000.00 - and it is the FILER'S OWN internal disagreement, not a transcription residual. The Summary Page Line 1 Column A, already transcribed in the totals tranche, reads 39,200.00. Both figures are retained verbatim; nothing was adjusted to close the gap.

itemized.notes: 6-page filing: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed), p3 Schedule A, pp4-6 Schedule B ('Page 1/2/3 of 3'). SCHEDULE A IS NOT THE PRINTED FORM - it is the filer's own typed LANDSCAPE spreadsheet attachment (the form invites this: 'Attach additional pages or your own spreadsheet if needed'), rendered rotated 90 degrees clockwise by poppler and read after a 90-degree counter-clockwise rotation; its geometry pointers are converted back to the portrait render as the contract requires. That sheet has NO DATE COLUMN at all, so all 49 contribution dates are blank by non-existence (not illegibility, and not a no-year case). IT ALSO HAS NO ADDRESS CONTENT: between 'First' and 'Occupation and Employer' there is a wide blank block with no header and no row rules - checked at 300dpi and it is genuinely white. Whether the address columns were hidden/deleted in the spreadsheet before printing or whited out at the county cannot be determined from the page, so donor_city/donor_state are blank and the ambiguity is stated rather than resolved. Names are given as separate Last / First cells and are transcribed in the sheet's own 'Last, First' order; 18 rows are organisations/PACs with an empty First cell. THE FILER'S OWN TWO CONTRIBUTION FIGURES DISAGREE BY $2,000 (Schedule A total 41,200 vs Summary Page Line 1 Column A 39,200.00) - see recon; both kept verbatim. Schedule B by contrast is the standard handwritten form and closes perfectly on all three pages. Schedule B row 11 is a $2,000.00 'Loan Reimbursement' paid to the candidate himself (Randy Horiuchi) - recorded as printed, not netted against anything. Vendor spellings are kept exactly as written including the filer's inconsistencies: 'Reagon outdoor signs' (p4 row 3) vs 'Reagan Outdoor Sign' (p4 row 6) vs 'Reagan outdoor signs' (p6 row 2); 'Shoutsign' vs 'Shout sign'; lowercase 'utah Pride Ctr.' and 'office Max'; and the misspelling 'evelopes' (XpedX, p5) and 'Milage' (p6). p4 row 7 'Post Master 82.50' has a superscript cents group that reads like a struck-through '50'; the page subtotal closing to the cent at 26,775.91 fixes it as .50.
